methods.averages: Representative component percentages weight the rated component values, renormalized over components with data. Every derived mean includes the sum of component percentages represented. Missing values remain null; they are never zero-filled.
methods.restriction_cm: First reported restriction per component; percentage-weighted mean only over components with a reported restriction. This conditional mean is not whole-unit soil thickness. No restriction record does not establish unlimited depth.
methods.described_profile_cm: Deepest described horizon bottom per component, including rock horizons if present. Describes database coverage, not soil thickness or bedrock depth.
methods.awc_0_100: Within each component, thickness-weight awc_r over described non-rock soil in the upper 100 cm, stopping at the first reported restriction or described profile bottom. Require continuous rated horizons over that interval. Then percentage-weight the component means. Units cm water / cm soil.
methods.clay_0_30: Same averaging as AWC over the upper 30 cm using claytotal_r, percent of the fine-earth fraction.
methods.om_0_30: Same averaging as AWC over the upper 30 cm using om_r, percent organic matter by weight.
methods.aws: NRCS muaggatt.aws0100wta and aws0150wta, multiplied by 10 to convert cm of water to mm. These are agency map-unit weighted water-storage summaries, separate from our AWC averaging. They do not include weathered-bedrock water.
methods.bedrock_min_cm: NRCS muaggatt.brockdepmin: shallowest bedrock depth among components comprising at least 15 percent of the map unit; not an average.
methods.drainage: Dominant-condition drainage and hydrologic group from NRCS muaggatt.
